text.n02: [annoyed] …What's with those weird clothes? Where are you from?
text.n03b: [gruff] I'm Nagisa. I guard the caravans on this pass. …And you're lost.
text.n07: [gruff] There's an inn below. …I'll carry you, so shut up and hold on.
text.h01: [excited] Welcome! …Oh, Nagisa! Picked up another stray?
text.n08: [gruff] Found him lying on the pass. …Hinata, something hot.
text.h02: [cheerful] Leave it to me! Yukimi Inn's famous bubbling hotpot! Here — steam and all!
text.h03: [playful] But it isn't free, you know? …Here, you pay with a bet!
text.h04: [excited] Big or small! Come on, which is it?
text.h05a: [pouting] No way, I lost?! …That didn't count! [laughs] …Just kidding. Here — scalding soup, winner first!
text.h05b: [laughs] Ahaha! I win! The loser drinks the scalding soup in one go!
text.h06: [whispers] …Hey. Truth is, I fiddled with the dice a bit just now. …Keep it secret.
text.h07: [laughs] Ahaha, your face is bright red! [curious] …Hey, what kind of games do people play in the future?
text.n09: [gruff] …Hinata. His ears are white. Go get Doctor Mint.
text.m02: [softly] …I'm Mint. A travelling doctor… I can heal you even half asleep, so don't worry…
text.m03: [softly] …Oh. Your ears are frozen through… nearly frostbitten…
text.m04: [whispers] …I'll do moxa. Held a little away, round and round… …Warm, isn't it.
text.m06: [softly] …Warm and cool together get the blood flowing… …Don't move.
text.m09: [whispers] …If you get sleepy, you can sleep… I'm a little… sleepy too…
text.m10: [softly] …Heh. Future people have the same ears… …Tell me, do you sleep well in the future…?
text.n11: [gruff] …The wind's coming from this side. Stay behind me.
text.n12: [softly] …You're a strange one. From the future… seriously?
text.n13: [softly] …I've always been the one guarding someone. …Nobody's ever guarded me.
text.n14: [curious] …What do people say at times like this, in the future?
text.n15a: [embarrassed] …Otsukare-sama — "thanks for your hard work." …Heh. I kinda like that.
text.n16: [whispers] …I'll stay right here till morning. …You can sleep.
text.h09: [excited] It's cleared up! You can cross the pass!
text.m11: [sleepy] …Go through that gate… and you can probably go home…
text.n17: [gruff] …Here. Before you go — take something from one of us.
text.m12: [whispers] …My star hairpin. …On nights you can't sleep, hold it. …I'll treat you again in your dreams.
text.h10: [whispers] …My dice! …Next time we meet, I'm winning for sure. …Wait for me, okay?
text.n18: [whispers] …My hair tie. …Don't lose it. …Next time, I'll come to your country to get you.
text.bm_future: [sleepy] …Smartphone…? What a strange word… Teach me future medicine someday…
text.bm_game: [softly] …Games are Hinata's thing… I just watch…
text.bm_food: [softly] …Hinata's hotpot is good, isn't it… there's ginger in it, it warms you up…
text.bm_cold: [softly] …The cold is hard, isn't it… The chill comes in through the ears… so take care of them…
text.bm_sleep: [sleepy] …Sleepy…? I know… I'm always sleepy too…
text.bm_praise: [softly] …Heh… Flattery won't make the medicine any sweeter…
text.bm_name: [softly] …Mint. Mint as in peppermint… the cool one…
text.bm_thanks: [softly] …You're welcome… The fee is a good night's sleep…
text.bm_leave: [softly] …You want to go home… But tonight you need rest… Wait for the pass until morning…
text.bm_no: [softly] …I see… Then tonight I'll make sure you sleep soundly…
text.bm_gen2: [sleepy] …Haah… Sorry, I dozed off a little… …Mm, you're right…
text.bh_future: [excited] Whoa! The future has stuff like that?! …But in a game, I won't lose!
text.bh_game: [excited] A game?! Nice, I'm in! …Let's play again later!
text.bh_food: [cheerful] Right?! Our hotpot is the best on the pass! There's seconds too!
text.bh_cold: [laughs] Ahaha, it's a blizzard out there! In here you'll stay warm!
text.bh_sleep: [playful] Eh, sleepy already? The night is just starting!
text.bh_praise: [flustered] Eh, ehehe… …Flattery won't make me go easy with the dice!
text.bh_name: [cheerful] I'm Hinata! The face of Yukimi Inn — and the house dealer!
text.bh_thanks: [cheerful] It's nothing, nothing! We all help each other in a pinch!
text.bh_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. …Of course. [cheerful] When the pass clears, I'll see you off!
text.bh_gen2: [curious] Hmm…? I don't really get it, but whatever!
text.bh_silence: [playful] Huh, shy? …That's fine, I'll do the talking!
text.bn_future: [gruff] …Smartphone? Never heard of it. [softly] …But I kinda want to see your country.
text.bn_food: [gruff] …Eat while you can. On the pass, that's what matters most.
text.bn_cold: [gruff] If you're cold, come closer. [embarrassed] …I-it doesn't mean anything weird.
text.bn_sleep: [softly] …If you're sleepy, sleep. Keeping watch is my job.
text.bn_name: [gruff] Nagisa. …Don't make me say it twice.
text.bn_thanks: [embarrassed] …No need to thank me. It's my job, that's all.
text.bn_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. …I know. In the morning I'll take you up to the pass.
text.bn_yes: [surprised] …No way. [softly] …No — you don't look like someone who lies.
text.bn_no: [gruff] …Figured. [curious] …But those clothes sure aren't from around here.
text.bn_gen2: [sighs] …I don't get half of what you say. [softly] …But fine, I'll listen.
text.bn_silence: [softly] …When we're quiet, all you hear is the wind.
text.tm1: [sleepy] …Oh. You came back…? I'll look at your ears once more…
text.tm2: [softly] …I got this medicine box from my teacher. Forty-eight little drawers…
text.tm3: [whispers] …Mint from the northern valleys, mugwort from the southern fields… I gather them as I travel…
text.tm5: [whispers] …That's all for today… …Good night. Sweet dreams…
text.th1: [excited] Oh, there you are! Alright, tonight we play again!
text.th2: [playful] These dice were my mum's. …So I can't afford to lose!
text.th3: [cheerful] Yukimi Inn is the warmest inn on the pass! The hotpot fire stays lit all night!
text.th4: [curious] Hey, are there inns in the future too? More fun than ours?
text.th5: [whispers] …Come again. Next time, let's play with no cheating?
text.tn2: [softly] My dad gave me this staff when I was a kid. …Better than a blade — it doesn't kill.
text.tn3: [gruff] The wind on the pass comes from the left. …So I always stand on the left.
text.tn4: [curious] …Does snow like this fall in your country too?
text.tt1: [excited] We all came to see you off!
text.tt2: [softly] …The morning sun is warm… Let's talk a little before you go…
text.tt3: [gruff] …Go on. If there's something you want to say, say it now.
text.tt4: [laughs] Even back in the future, don't forget Yukimi Inn!
text.pm1: [sleepy] …So cold… I followed you all the way up here… Your ears will freeze again…?
text.pm2: [softly] …On snowy days the ears go cold first. Turn away from the wind and cup them with your hands, like this…
text.pm3: [whispers] …My hands are warm, aren't they… I was holding the moxa until a moment ago…
text.pm4: [sleepy] …Mm. Let's go back to the inn…? You mustn't fall asleep in a blizzard…
text.ph1: [shouting] Hey! You can't go out on the pass in a blizzard like this!
text.ph2: [playful] Here — a warming stone! I heated it on the hotpot fire. On your cheek — there!
text.ph3: [laughs] Ahaha, I'd never lose a snowball fight! …Not in this wind, though.
text.ph4: [cheerful] Right, back to a scalding hotpot! The bet comes after!
text.pn1: [gruff] …You came up here again? The pass in a blizzard isn't a playground.
text.pn2: [gruff] I'll stand on your left. …I'm good for blocking the wind, at least.
text.pn3: [softly] …This is where I found you. Buried in snow, all white. …I really panicked.
text.pn4: [whispers] …Don't wander off on your own again. …We're going back.
text.hm1: [sleepy] …Mm… The smell of Hinata's hotpot woke me up…
text.hm2: [softly] …This steam is good for your throat. Ginger, jujube, goji berries… Breathe it in slowly…
text.hm3: [softly] …It's warm by the brazier… My eyelids are getting heavy…
text.hm4: [whispers] …After you eat, go straight to sleep… It's your medicine before bed…
text.hn2: [softly] …Everyone who crosses the pass comes back to life with this hotpot. I did too.
text.hn3: [embarrassed] …Don't expect me to blow on it for you. …Cool it yourself.
text.hn4: [whispers] …Eat, then sleep. I'll watch the door.
text.ht6: [laughs] Alright, seconds for everyone! Tonight it's hotpot all night long!
text.hr1: [whispers] …Shh. Doctor Mint fell asleep again. …Quietly, okay?
text.hr2: [playful] Hey, shall we open just one drawer of her medicine box? …Kidding, kidding — she'd scold us!
text.hr3: [softly] …You know, the doctor actually watched over your ears all night. …Keep it secret.
text.hr4: [whispers] …Guess I'll go to bed too. …Good night, see you tomorrow!
text.nr1: [gruff] …The doctor's asleep. …Do your ears still hurt?
text.nr2: [softly] I froze my fingers on the pass once, too. She treated them all night.
text.nr3: [embarrassed] …You smell of mint too. …N-not that I was sniffing you.
text.nr4: [whispers] …Sleep. When she wakes up, I'll tell her.
text.dm1: [sleepy] …Haah… The night wind woke me up…
text.dm2: [softly] …The draught is hitting your left ear… Here, take my coat…
text.dm3: [softly] …Snow at night swallows sound… That's why it's so quiet…
text.dm4: [whispers] …Come on, let's sleep again…? I'll watch over you, right here…
text.dh1: [surprised] Whoa, cold! …The door's blown open again!
text.dh2: [cheerful] Hup…! I've wedged it shut — all good now!
text.dh3: [playful] Hey, if you can't sleep, how about one roll of the dice? …Quietly.
text.dh4: [whispers] …Just kidding. Go sleep by the brazier, okay? …Good night.
text.wm2: [softly] …The snow is sparkling… Isn't it too bright for your eyes…?
text.wm3: [whispers] …Even back there, don't let your ears get cold… Promise…
text.wh1: [excited] Look, look, the sunrise! The pass is all gold!
text.wh3: [playful] …Hey, one last bet? If you win, you have to come back!
text.wh4: [whispers] …And if I win, you come back too. …Unfair? Hehe.
text.wn2: [softly] …The pass at dawn is this quiet. …I'm glad I got to see it with you.
text.wn3: [gruff] …Through that gate is your country, right? …Don't get lost.
text.bm_p_wind: [softly] …The wind is strong… Keep your ears covered with your hands…
text.bh_p_wind: [laughs] Ahaha, my hair's a mess! I won't lose to some wind!
text.bn_p_wind: [gruff] …This wind is a gentle one. …Stay in my shelter.
text.bm_p_pot: [softly] …The brazier's charcoal is crackling… Nice sound…
text.bh_p_pot: [cheerful] I keep the hotpot fire going all night! Ahem!
text.bn_p_pot: [gruff] …Stay by the fire. You're still pale.
text.bm_p_cure: [whispers] …Moxa and mint: warm, then cool, taking turns…
text.bh_p_cure: [curious] Isn't the moxa hot? I've always been too scared to try it!
text.bn_p_cure: [softly] …Her treatment works. I can vouch for it.
text.bm_p_door: [sleepy] …Night watch is hard work… Nagisa stays up all night…
text.bh_p_door: [playful] The door at night is a bit scary, right? …But Nagisa's here, so it's fine!
text.bn_p_door: [gruff] I've got the door. …You stay by the fire.
text.bm_p_sun: [softly] …The morning sun is bright… Did you sleep well last night…?
text.bh_p_sun: [excited] When the sun's up, the pass can be crossed! That's the Yukimi Inn saying!
